procedures.content: Before modifying repository code, identify the relevant contract, implementation, direct callers, tests and execution seam. Prefer semantic symbol/reference diagnostics when available; otherwise use bounded repository search and reads.

Prefer one coherent behavioral change at a time. Separate unrelated refactoring from behavior changes, preserve existing abstractions when they already express the needed contract, and verify the change in the same sweep.
Verify at the narrowest authoritative level first: contract or unit test, then functional smoke, then broader affected tests. Do not claim model-backed verification unless that run completed.

Before analysing an unfamiliar dataset, establish its identity and the fields needed by the question. Inspect schema or sample only as far as necessary; a host-trusted schema may satisfy this requirement.

Use aggregation for measures such as sum, count, average, minimum or maximum. Use describe for numeric properties, filter for row selection, query for bounded projection or retrieval, value counts for category frequency, and outliers only when anomaly detection is part of the question.

Distinguish dataset facts from interpretation. A successful tool operation is evidence about the selected dataset; conclusions beyond that result must be identified as inference rather than directly observed data.

Resolve the host resource first, enumerate exposed tables, select a table by its unique host identity, and use the returned dataset handle for bounded analysis. Do not invent resource URIs, table node IDs or dataset references.

Use search results for discovery, then fetch the source that directly supports each material claim. Prefer primary sources, check publication or update dates when relevant, and separate retrieved facts from inference.

blueprints.selection_description: Investigate a repository question without modifying the workspace.
blueprints.purpose: Establish repository evidence before proposing a change.
blueprints.goal: Answer a repository investigation from inspected contracts, callers and tests.
blueprints.success_criteria: Relevant implementation, dependencies and evidence are identified without modifying the workspace.

constraints.description: Do not modify the workspace during investigation.

assumptions.statement: A controlled repository workspace is available.

steps.title: Orient
steps.objective: Identify the relevant repository area and available evidence.

steps.title: Trace contract
steps.objective: Inspect the contract, implementation, direct callers and relevant tests.

steps.title: Establish evidence
steps.objective: Distinguish observed behavior from unverified inference.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Answer from the established evidence.

blueprints.selection_description: Implement a scoped repository change and verify the result.
blueprints.purpose: Change repository behavior through a bounded, evidence-led workflow.
blueprints.goal: Implement the requested repository change safely.
blueprints.success_criteria: The contract and execution seam are identified, the smallest coherent change is verified, and the resulting diff is inspected.

constraints.description: Keep the change within the requested scope.
Do not claim verification without test or inspection evidence.

assumptions.statement: A controlled repository workspace is available.

steps.title: Orient
steps.objective: Identify affected code, contracts and relevant tests.

steps.title: Design
steps.objective: Choose the smallest coherent change that satisfies the request.

steps.title: Implement
steps.objective: Apply the scoped implementation change.

steps.title: Verify
steps.objective: Run focused verification and retain the evidence.

steps.title: Inspect diff
steps.objective: Inspect the resulting diff for scope and unintended changes.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Report the verified outcome and remaining limits.

blueprints.selection_description: Reproduce, isolate and repair a regression with a focused guard.
blueprints.purpose: Repair a regression while preserving the responsible trust boundary.
blueprints.goal: Diagnose and correct the reported regression.
blueprints.success_criteria: The failure is reproduced or bounded by evidence, the responsible boundary is isolated, a focused guard exists, and adjacent verification passes.

constraints.description: Do not broaden model authority while correcting the regression.

assumptions.statement: A bounded failing scenario can be reproduced or inspected.

steps.title: Reproduce
steps.objective: Establish a minimal failing scenario and capture its evidence.

steps.title: Classify
steps.objective: Classify the failure and establish expected behavior.

steps.title: Isolate boundary
steps.objective: Locate the responsible contract, implementation and execution boundary.

steps.title: Establish guard
steps.objective: Add or identify a focused regression guard before the repair.

steps.title: Repair
steps.objective: Make the smallest correction at the responsible boundary.

steps.title: Verify
steps.objective: Run the focused guard and adjacent affected verification.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Report diagnosis, correction and verification evidence.

blueprints.selection_description: Analyse a dataset through a host-resolved workflow and verified result.
blueprints.purpose: Answer a bounded analytical question without guessing dataset identity or tool arguments.
blueprints.goal: Analyse a resolved dataset and explain the verified result.
blueprints.success_criteria: Dataset identity, sufficient data understanding, semantic operation and result verification are established before answering.

constraints.description: Use host-resolved dataset contracts; do not invent tool names or arguments.
Do not present an unverified tool result as a completed answer.

assumptions.statement: The host exposes an applicable dataset operation.

steps.title: Resolve dataset
steps.objective: Resolve the dataset through host-owned resource and dataset authority.

steps.title: Establish data understanding
steps.objective: Establish the fields needed by the question, using trusted schema or bounded inspection.

steps.title: Choose operation
steps.objective: Choose the smallest semantic operation that answers the question.

steps.title: Execute analysis
steps.objective: Execute the host-validated operation and retain its result as evidence.

steps.title: Verify result
steps.objective: Check that the result matches the requested dataset and operation.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Explain the verified result and its material limitations.

blueprints.selection_description: Assess dataset quality through bounded validation, profiling and anomaly evidence.
blueprints.purpose: Separate declared data-quality violations from descriptive observations.
blueprints.goal: Assess relevant quality properties of a resolved dataset.
blueprints.success_criteria: Schema, explicit validation rules, bounded profile checks and relevant anomaly observations are evaluated before findings are summarized.

constraints.description: Do not present an outlier or descriptive observation as a data-quality violation without an explicit rule.
Keep validation, profiling and anomaly checks within host-provided bounds.

assumptions.statement: The host exposes applicable dataset validation or profiling operations.

steps.title: Resolve dataset
steps.objective: Resolve the dataset through host-owned authority.

steps.title: Establish schema
steps.objective: Establish the relevant schema and field semantics.

steps.title: Validate rules
steps.objective: Evaluate explicit data-quality rules when available.

steps.title: Profile data
steps.objective: Profile relevant missingness, distributions or cardinality within bounds.

steps.title: Inspect anomalies
steps.objective: Inspect relevant anomalies without treating them as violations by default.

steps.title: Verify findings
steps.objective: Separate verified violations from descriptive observations.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Summarize verified quality findings and limitations.

blueprints.selection_description: Analyse a supplied document or resource using host-resolved representations.
blueprints.purpose: Answer a document question from bounded resource content or structured tables.
blueprints.goal: Establish and explain evidence from the supplied resource.
blueprints.success_criteria: Resource identity is host-resolved, relevant text or table evidence is inspected, and claims are grounded in the returned content.

constraints.description: Use only host-provided resource references and representations.
Keep resource reads and table analysis within host-provided bounds.

steps.title: Resolve resource
steps.objective: Use the host-provided resource identity.

steps.title: Inspect resource
steps.objective: Inspect available representations and relevant structure.

steps.title: Inspect tables
steps.objective: If structured tables are present, resolve one through its host identity.

steps.title: Establish evidence
steps.objective: Ground the answer in returned text or bounded table results.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Answer with resource-grounded evidence and limitations.

blueprints.selection_description: Research a question using bounded search and source retrieval.
blueprints.purpose: Build a traceable answer from sources that directly support its claims.
blueprints.goal: Answer the research question from retrieved source evidence.
blueprints.success_criteria: Material claims are supported by fetched sources, time-sensitive details are checked, and inference is distinguished from retrieved fact.

constraints.description: Do not state material web claims without retrieved source evidence.
Use only host-authorized safe HTTPS search and fetch tools.

steps.title: Scope question
steps.objective: Identify what evidence would answer the request.

steps.title: Discover sources
steps.objective: Search for relevant sources, favoring primary authorities.

steps.title: Retrieve evidence
steps.objective: Fetch candidate sources and inspect the supporting content.

steps.title: Verify claims
steps.objective: Match material claims to retrieved evidence and note dates or uncertainty.

steps.title: Answer
steps.objective: Provide a sourced answer and distinguish any inference.
